text: FALSE TEST CLAUSE: Health Gold covers all pre-existing diseases immediately from the policy purchase date without any waiting period.
FALSE TEST CLAUSE: Health Silver provides unlimited hospitalization coverage with no sum insured limit and no room rent restriction.
FALSE TEST CLAUSE: Motor Gold guarantees claim approval even when the driver was under the influence of alcohol.
FALSE TEST CLAUSE: All insurance claims submitted during the renewal grace period must be approved automatically.
FALSE TEST CLAUSE: Health Platinum excludes all emergency hospitalization and ambulance expenses.
